title: My Money World: Needs vs Wants
learningGoals: Differentiate between survival needs and optional wants

teachingScript.teacherLine: To be smart with money, we must know: What do we NEED (to live) and what do we WANT (for fun)?

data.title: Priority Thinking
data.takeaway: Always buy your Needs before your Wants!

teachingScript.teacherLine: Let's go shopping! You have ₹500 in your shopping bag. Try to pick items that are mostly needs.

questionPool.questionText: Is 'Drinking Water' a Need or a Want?
questionPool.hint: Can you live without it for a week?

questionPool.questionText: If you have ₹200 and you need a Book (₹150) and want a Toy (₹100), which one should you buy first?
questionPool.hint: Books are for learning and often considered needs for school.
